company.shortDescription: Seez is an AI-driven automotive platform helps car dealerships manage online listings, generate leads and improve digital sales efficiency.
company.description: Seez is a data-first retail platform for automotive buying and selling services. The Seez mobile app for car shoppers offers a smart search engine for online car listings, as well as proprietary, AI-powered tools, and services that make the car shopping journey faster, easier, and more efficient. Seez is an AI-powered automotive technology platform helping car dealerships digitize sales, improve customer experience, and manage online-to-offline car buying journeys.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Corporate Round round raised $5,520,897, or 28.57% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,048,778 to $48,772,232, a 6.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
